statements.status_notes: GMS-2017-215 flags the slug npm package under OWASP A9 (known-vulnerable components). slug is an unmaintained transitive dependency in the Trigger.dev webapp dependency tree with no published fix version. Assessing whether slug is invoked at runtime in the self-hosted webapp or only pulled in as dead weight from legacy packages.

GMS-2017-215 flags the slug npm package under OWASP A9 (known-vulnerable components). slug is an unmaintained transitive dependency in the Trigger.dev webapp dependency tree with no published fix version. Assessing whether slug is invoked at runtime in the self-hosted webapp or only pulled in as dead weight from legacy packages.

GMS-2017-215 is an unspecified severity advisory for the slug npm package with no fixed version available. The vulnerability affects all versions (>=0.0.0-alpha). Investigation is ongoing to determine if the vulnerable code paths are reachable in the unleash application context and whether alternative mitigations are feasible.
